thread.title: Special Participation A: Exploration of Different Input Forms on HW5 (ChatGPT 5.1 Auto)
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>When we use large language models to solve knowledge-based problems, we may encounter the input of images/formulas. Taking hw5 as an example, I tried：</paragraph><paragraph><break/>1) text input only (without any formulas), <break/>2) text input + image input (there might be some formula garbled), <break/>3) inputting the entire question as an image, <break/>4) directly inputting the pdf. </paragraph><paragraph><break/>Then, I observed the problem-solving capabilities of the large language model under different inputs.</paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/gMKTLrtCeOkBVMOb5X4hAw6C" filename="Exploration of Different Input Forms on HW5 (ChatGPT 5.1 Auto).pdf"/><paragraph/></document>
thread.document:
When we use large language models to solve knowledge-based problems, we may encounter the input of images/formulas. Taking hw5 as an example, I tried：


1) text input only (without any formulas), 
2) text input + image input (there might be some formula garbled), 
3) inputting the entire question as an image, 
4) directly inputting the pdf. 


Then, I observed the problem-solving capabilities of the large language model under different inputs.
